crossRefs.note: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word…
In the fourth year of king Darius, Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of…
Then work stopped on God’s house which is at Jerusalem. It stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of…
This house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai…
in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet…
Yahweh’s word came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,
Now the prophets, Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews who were in Judah and…
that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of…
from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you…
of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

people.name: Darius
people.line: Persian king who decreed the rebuilding of the Temple

people.name: Iddo
people.line: Zechariah's grandfather, a priest and prophet in post-exilic Judah

people.name: Zechariah
people.line: Post-exilic prophet who wrote the book of Zechariah

translations.web: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, the prophet, saying,
translations.bsb: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying:
translations.kjv: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
translations.asv: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of Jehovah unto Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, the prophet, saying,
